Three merged PRs on the main line since 2026-04-11 added or removed a line containing `configUrls` under `packages/tooling/openmrs`. I took the pinned head to be `main` at `7a172083`, the current tip.

1. **#1905**, "(docs) Rewrite the openmrs CLI README around how it's used", merged 2026-10-02 (commit `b439966`). It rewrote the `--help` epilog in `cli.ts`, replacing the old line that listed `configUrls` with a new one, and added `configUrls` lines to `README.md`.
2. **#1894**, "(BREAKING) Remove offline & rxjs support from framework", merged 2026-09-28 (commit `a62f816`). It collapsed the `runDevelop` destructuring in `develop.ts` into one line that still contains `configUrls`, removing the old multi-line `configUrls,` entry.
3. **#1743**, "(BREAKING) Drop IMO and don't load arbitrary content in production mode", merged 2026-04-15 (commit `1dcccfd`). It renamed `loadBundlerConfig` to `setBundlerEnv` in `config.test.ts`, which changed the `configUrls` test line.

I checked the cumulative diff from before #1743 to `main` for all nine files in the path that contain `configUrls`, and the per-commit diffs for #1894 and #1905. No other commit changed a `configUrls` line. Merge dates are Falkon's `mergedAt` values in UTC.
